prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Atlanta for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone—the right choice depends on your case, location, budget, and how comfortable you feel with the doctor. A few Atlanta-area options worth comparing are:

- **West Paces Ferry Orthodontics** — offers braces and Invisalign; its practice reports Diamond Plus Invisalign provider status. [Website](https://www.westpacesferryortho.com/)
- **Buckhead Orthodontics** — offers traditional braces and clear aligners; Dr. Michael Everson is listed as board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics. [Website](https://nationalorthodonticregistry.com/georgia/atlanta-ga/orthodontists/buckhead-orthodontics-atlanta-ga)
- **Harris Orthodontics** — offers braces and Invisalign; Dr. Peyton Harris reports board certification. [Website](https://harrisorthodonticsatl.com/)
- **Wright Orthodontics** — offers braces and Invisalign, with strong patient-review ratings in the search results. [Website](https://nationalorthodonticregistry.com/georgia/atlanta-ga/orthodontists/wright-orthodontics-atlanta-ga)

I’d book two or three consultations before deciding. Ask who will supervise your treatment, whether your case is suitable for Invisalign or braces, what’s included in the quoted fee (including retainers and refinements), and how emergencies or missed appointments are handled. You can also verify an orthodontist through the [American Association of Orthodontists’ locator](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/).
